{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}')

# Check how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f'Patients with multiple entries ({len(duplicates)}): {list(duplicates.index)}')

# Check assay_batch distribution
batch_dist = df['assay_batch'].value_counts()
print(f'Assay batch distribution:
{batch_dist}')

# Check sample_seq distribution
seq_dist = df['sample_seq'].value_counts()
print(f'Sample sequence distribution:
{seq_dist}')

# Confirm the highest sample_seq per patient is the one we want
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(df_grouped[df_grouped["sample_seq"] > 1])}')"}
